content.text: {"answer":"Quarrendon Freight Lines","citations":["D106"],"explanation":"In D106 (North weekly 2025-09-15), the phrase \"Dana's freight account\" appears in the Quarrendon Freight Lines section, where Dana Okafor is checking the roster.
